(429)༄༅/yum ka'i gter bum sgrub pa'i lhan thabs kyi 'don 'grigs bzhugs/sems bskyed sdom chogayum ka'i brgyud 'debs/skyabs sems nas bstod pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ yum ka'i gter bum sgrub pa'i lhan thabs kyi 'don 'grigs bzhugs/ sems bskyed sdom chog yum ka'i brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems nas bstod pa yan song nas/ gter bum gyi/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar= sogs/ rtsa sngags stong*/ las sgrub gzungs brgya/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya/ rten snying gsum/ mchod phreng*/ las gzhung gi mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ gsol ka'i nang*/ tshe ring ma grangs ci mang bsag gser skyems yan/ na rag skong bshags/ yum ka'i tshogs bar bshags yan/ skong bshags nang*/ tshogs brgya bsag mdor na rab 'byams= mthar/ bse rags bkar dgos pas/ a ka ro= lan gsum/ thing gsum/ zil/ rkang bzhi/ dung*/ dgu thing*/ kyeḥ srid gsum 'di na= sogs/ mthar/ dgu thing*/ tshar bzhi/ dgu thing re/ dgu thing*/ tha mar/ dung*/ gats+tsha: zil nang*/ mdos bskyal/ sum gnyis/ hrī: snod bcud sprul pa'i= sum gcig zil/ sum bha ni= rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ srung 'khor/ sum gnyis/ bkra shis/ sum gcig zil/ rkang gsum/ rgya/ (Musical notes and signs here) nas/ (Musical notes and signs here) dgra lha'i rdzas/ hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas= sogs g.yang 'gugs/ ri rgyal lhun po= khyad par g.yang can= gnyis kyi mgor/ dgu rkyang re rgyags/ mthar dgu rkyang*/ zil/ bzhag sngags ring brgya/ thing gcig zil/ sum gnyis/ g.yang 'gugs/ sum gcig zil/ bzhag sngags brgya/ de (430) 'gres kyis g.yang 'gugs tshar brgya/ sngags stong 'gro dgos/ drang*/ lhag gsol ka bskul/ chad/ brtan/ bro/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ dngos grub zhi rol/ sbyin bdag stan la 'khod/ thing gsum/ dgu rkyang gis g.yang 'gugs tshar gcig zil/ sum gnyis/ ma chags thogs med= sum gcig zil nang*/ g.yang rten rnams rgyun du 'jog sar dgod/ bzhag rol/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis rol chen/ bzang spyod man spyi ltar ro//
